mutations.name: a completed result drops its restart count
kills: step timing on a completed result records a single try's start as both its start and its first start, with no restarts
step timing on a completed result keeps the first start and the restart count after a restart re-dispatches the step

mutations.name: events go out without the runtime clock's time
kills: workflow events carry the runtime clock's time as `at`

mutations.name: a code record route drops its body's usage
kills: a code record route that reports usage records the usage as the step's and keeps it off the stored record
a code record route that reports usage is summed against a fan-out's budget like a dispatch's usage

mutations.name: the trace places an attempt at its completion even when its start is recorded
kills: step timing on a completed result traces an attempt at the start its result recorded
